content.short: CroSwap facilitates automated trading of DeFi tokens on multiple blockchain networks.
content.description: CroSwap is an AMM-based decentralized exchange that enables automated trading of DeFi tokens across multiple blockchain networks. It aims to be a user-friendly platform for learning, swapping, and earning high yields in decentralized finance. CroSwap uses EIP-2535 Diamond standard contracts to enable modular upgrades that have no impact on the user base, helping traders stay ahead in the rapidly evolving crypto landscape. This approach ensures upgrades do not disrupt active users.
content.meta: CroSwap is an AMM-based DEX for automated DeFi token trading across blockchains. Discover CroSwap and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
